text.tspan: Vigil reads your alerts, changes, logs and metrics, then tells you
what broke and why, with a link to every piece of evidence it used.

text.font-family: "Bricolage Grotesque Variable", "Bricolage Grotesque", "Geist Variable", system-ui, sans-serif
"Bricolage Grotesque Variable", "Bricolage Grotesque", "Geist Variable", system-ui, sans-serif

text.tspan: Each likely cause carries the evidence for it and against it. Weak
ideas are ruled out in writing, so nobody chases them on the
Figures from the demo workspace, sample data.

text.tspan: Ruled out: network status and synthetic checks healthy
What caused the login slowdown at 14:05?

text.font-family: "Bricolage Grotesque Variable", "Bricolage Grotesque", "Geist Variable", system-ui, sans-serif

text.tspan: No change, alert or metric explains it with enough confidence.

text.tspan: A confident wrong answer at 3am costs more than an honest one.
Vigil says "I don't know" early and tells you what would settle it.

choose, or run a model inside your own network. Vigil never sends
your data to train anyone's model.
